def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x in (1,2)]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts if g[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]==1 else pts[::-1]
    dr,dcr=r2-r1,c2-c1
    sgn=lambda n: (n>0)-(n<0)
    rd,cd=sgn(dr),sgn(dcr)
    n=min(abs(dr),abs(dcr))
    r,c=r1,c1
    for _ in range(n):
        r+=rd; c+=cd
        if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=3
    for _ in range(abs(dr)-n if abs(dr)>n else abs(dcr)-n):
        r+= (rd if abs(dr)>n else 0); c+= (cd if abs(dcr)>n else 0)
        if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=3
    return g

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x in (1,2)]
    (r1,c1)=next(p for p in pts if g[p[0]][p[1]]==1)

    sgn=lambda n:(n>0)-(n<0)
    dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
    rd,cd=sgn(dr),sgn(dc)
    m=min(abs(dr),abs(dc))
    r,c=r1,c1
    for k in range(m-1):  # diagonal
        r+=rd; c+=cd
        g[r][c]=3
    # straight for the excess, then final diagonal onto 2
    if abs(dc)>m:
        for k in range(abs(dc)-m):
            c+=cd; g[r][c]=3
    else:
        for k in range(abs(dr)-m):
            r+=rd; g[r][c]=3
    return g
